mapper.select: select cast(id as char) as id,goods_name as name,spec,unit from psi_goods where tenant_id=#{tenant} and deleted=0 and status=1 and (goods_name like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or goods_code like concat('%',#{keyword},'%')) order by goods_name,id limit 30
select cast(id as char) as id,warehouse_name as name from psi_warehouse where tenant_id=#{tenant} and deleted=0 and status=1 order by is_default desc,id limit 100
select cast(id as char) as id,goods_name as name,spec,unit,sale_price,purchase_price from psi_goods where id=#{id} and tenant_id=#{tenant} and deleted=0 and status=1

select cast(m.id as char) as id,m.material_name,g.spec as specification,w.warehouse_name,m.quantity,m.remark from eoms_repair_material m join eoms_repair_order o on m.repair_order_id=o.id left join psi_goods g on g.id=m.material_id and g.tenant_id=o.tenant_id and g.deleted=0 left join psi_warehouse w on w.id=m.warehouse_id and w.tenant_id=o.tenant_id and w.deleted=0 where o.id=#{orderId} and o.tenant_id=#{tenant} and o.del_flag='0' and m.del_flag='0' order by m.id
